annotations.title: Ver la ficha de unas obras

description: Use this when the user wants to know more about particular buildings: who designed them and when, where they are, what they are like, why they matter, whether they can be visited and what else Builtalist has about them (a story, an audio guide, a competition). Gives the Builtalist entry of up to 5 works, by the id that comes with each work in a search, or by name.

ids.description: Ids of works, as they come in a search: bt-0002f3afcc.

nombres.description: Names of works, as precise as possible, with the city if it helps: "Casa da Música, Porto".
